#+title: Consumer-owned Org Element queries

* Active reviews
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.active-review
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline
              (all-of (property todo-type "todo")
                      (property-contains source-title "Review"))
              (descendant-of scope))
#+end_src

* Cited evidence
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.cited-evidence
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements citation-reference (property key "doe2020"))
#+end_src

* Normalized review title
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.normalized-title
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline (property title "Review patch"))
#+end_src

* Priority reviews
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.priority
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline (property priority "A"))
#+end_src

* Tagged reviews
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.tagged
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline (property tags "work"))
#+end_src

* Raw headline value
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.raw-value
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline (property raw-value "WAIT [#A] Review patch :work:"))
#+end_src

* Partial TODO keyword
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.todo-contains
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements-query
(org-elements headline
              (all-of (property-contains todo-keyword "WAI")
                      (property-contains title "Review")))
#+end_src
